android.desc: Chavah Messianic Radio is a radio station that plays your favorite Messianic Jewish and Hebrew Roots music. You can thumb-up (or down) songs, and Chavah will play more of the stuff you like. You can request songs be played, and they'll play for you and everyone listening. No sign-up required - just launch the app and start listening to Messiah's musicians from Israel and around the world.

quotes.text:
I have a music player PWA published on Android[0]. It works pretty good, my users are happy (rated 4.5 stars), and I haven't encountered any significant issues with it.

For the file system access API, only the origin private file system is enabled on Android[1].

IMO, the file system access APIs are still a bit immature.

[0]: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.messianicradio

[1]: https://caniuse.com/native-filesystem-api
